title: San Francisco
description: Fog, hills, and Painted Ladies — how well do you know the City by the Bay?

questions.prompt: Which San Francisco neighborhood was the epicenter of the 1967 'Summer of Love' counterculture movement?
questions.explanation: Haight-Ashbury — the intersection of Haight and Ashbury streets — drew tens of thousands of young people during the 1967 Summer of Love (Wikipedia: 'Summer of Love').

questions.prompt: Which neighborhood is historically known as San Francisco's 'Little Italy'?
questions.explanation: North Beach has been the city's Italian-American enclave since the late 1800s, and still hosts the annual North Beach Festival (Wikipedia: 'North Beach, San Francisco').
